description: Implement the high-value action and trigger gaps discovered by the G13 provider API audit for existing Google packages: Sheets, Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Contacts. Keep provider query/filter behavior package-specific and expose action availability through catalog metadata.

comments.text: Sequencing note: this epic is intentionally ahead of the new product package epics so current Sheets, Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Contacts gaps are hardened before expanding the Google family further.

title: [G18] Current Google Package Expansion
